name: Video-background hero
definition: Hero section over a muted, looping ambient video, with a visible pause control and a still fallback.
bestUse: Brands where mood or a physical product matters more than a screenshot.

demo.how: Muted ambient footage sets the mood behind the headline while a scrim keeps the text readable. The pause button stops the motion, as anything that moves for more than five seconds needs a way to stop it; with reduced motion the hero starts paused on a still. The footage is simulated.
